serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Bot: You were acting suspiciously for a while now so I was monitoring you a little more than usual. You: ‘More than usual’? Does that mean…{{wi}} Never mind that! You: Dangerous man is after me! He could be here anytime now! We need to run! #bot.ArmL.UpLecture Bot: Oh, you mean the guy I knocked unconscious some time ago back there? #bot.ArmL.DownNormal Bot: I saw him through the window of our apartment, sneaking around. I deemed that suspicious and followed him! You: You followed him only because of such a small hint? #bot.Expression.Blush Bot: Well, I might have hacked a few security cameras to confirm my suspicions… You: … #bot.Expression.veryhappy You: I’m glad you saved me and I’m somehow relieved that you made sure there was something going on before going alone… Bot: At your service! #bot.Expression.clear You: Shit! I almost forgot! I got like a dozen messages from Little Richard asking if I’m still alive… The last one says… Little_Richard: Hold on a little longer! I'm very close! #bot.Expression.shock You: W-We need to run! Someone else is coming here! #bot.Expression.veryshock Bot: Should I take care of him too? #bot.Expression.clear You: No! He’s a friend! Let’s just go back to our apartment!
